note: Food (English key, see data/open/aliases.json) -> one source record, picked by hand on 2026-10-19. source: ciqual (Ciqual 2025 alim_code), usda_foundation or usda_sr_legacy (FDC id). state is how the grams are weighed in a recipe. review: a judgment call, listed in data/open/nutrition/review.md. Rebuild with data/build/build_nutrition.py.

almond butter.note: Almond butter, creamy. Not in Ciqual.

almond flour.note: Peeled almonds, used for almond flour.
almond flour.review: No almond flour record. Blanched almond flour is ground peeled almonds, so the macros match; defatted almond flour has less fat.

almonds.note: Almonds with skin, no added salt.

anchovies in oil.note: Anchovy fillets, salted, in olive oil, drained.

bacon.review: European bacon. US streaky bacon is fattier: about 390 kcal and 37 g fat (USDA 168277).

bagel.note: Plain bagel. No bagel in Ciqual.

basmati rice.note: Thai or basmati rice, raw (dry grams).

beef steak.review: Cut varies by shop. Topside used as the usual lean fillet; rump (6206) is close, rib steak is far fattier.

beetroot.review: Cooked beetroot (vacuum packs, common in Spain) is close: Ciqual 20003 lists 41.5 kcal per 100 g.

blueberries.review: Ciqual 'myrtille' covers blueberry and bilberry; cultivated blueberries may be a little sweeter.

bulgur.note: Bulgur, dry (dry grams). No bulgur in Ciqual.

canned black beans.note: Canned black beans, drained and rinsed. No black beans in Ciqual.

canned lentils.review: Ciqual's canned lentils are 'cuisinée' (lightly seasoned); plain jarred lentils are close.

canned mackerel.note: Canned mackerel fillets in brine, drained.
canned mackerel.review: No mackerel in oil record. Mackerel in olive oil, drained, may carry a few g more fat.

canned pinto beans.note: Canned pinto beans, drained and rinsed.

canned tuna in oil.note: Whole tuna in sunflower oil, drained.
canned tuna in oil.review: Assumes sunflower oil, the usual cheap pack. Tuna in olive oil is close (Ciqual 26179).

capers.note: Capers, canned. Ciqual has no energy value for capers.

chia seeds.note: Dried chia seed. Carbs exclude fiber (about 34 g).

chicken broth.review: Ready-to-use carton broth assumed; homemade broth can have more fat.

chicken meat.note: Chicken meat without skin, raw (average of cuts), for a name that says only chicken.
chicken meat.review: Plain "pollo" or "chicken" counts as this record through a word rule (decided 2026-11-21). Breast is 110 kcal and 23.4 g protein; chicken leg with skin (Ciqual 36002) is 192 kcal.

chicken thigh.note: Chicken thigh meat without skin, raw.

chicken wings.note: Chicken wing, meat and skin, raw (weighed without bone).

chili flakes.note: Cayenne pepper powder, used for dried chili flakes.
chili flakes.review: No chili flake record; cayenne powder is the same dried pepper.

chorizo.note: Spicy pork sausage with red pepper (chorizo), not dried.
chorizo.review: Chorizo varies a lot: Spanish cured chorizo is about 475 kcal (its own food), Mexican raw chorizo about 300 (its own food).

cooked quinoa.note: Quinoa boiled in water, no salt.

corn tortillas.note: Corn tortillas, ready to heat. Mexican nixtamal tortillas.
corn tortillas.review: USDA used: the Ciqual corn wrap (7813, 316 kcal) is a European wrap with wheat and oil, unlike Mexican tortillas.

cottage cheese.note: Cottage cheese, full fat (about 4%). No cottage cheese in Ciqual.

cream cheese.note: Spreadable fresh cheese, plain, full fat.
cream cheese.review: European spreadable cream cheese (225 kcal). US block cream cheese is richer: about 340 kcal (USDA 2346385).

crushed tomatoes.note: Canned tomato flesh without skin (crushed tomatoes).

cumin.note: Cumin seed (ground cumin is the same food).

cured chorizo.note: Spanish cured chorizo (dry spicy pork sausage).

dried lentils.note: Dried lentils, average of types (dry grams).

dry sausage.note: Dry-cured pork sausage, used for salchichon and fuet.

egg noodles.note: Asian wheat and egg noodles, dry (dry grams).

eggs.note: Whole hen egg, raw. Grams come from units by size.

fresh ginger.review: Ciqual lists 33 kcal per 100 g; USDA (169231) lists 80. Used in small amounts, so the gap is a few kcal.

fresh tuna.review: Fresh tuna species varies (yellowfin, albacore/bonito, bluefin). Bluefin has about 6 g more fat per 100 g.

frozen chicken.note: Chicken meat without skin, raw, used for plain frozen chicken (stated exception: no frozen record).
frozen chicken.review: Exception decided 2026-11-21: no plain frozen chicken record in Ciqual or USDA, so the raw record is used. Plain frozen raw chicken only; breaded, sauced or cooked products are never matched to it.

frozen chicken breast.note: Chicken breast without skin, raw, used for plain frozen chicken breast (stated exception: no frozen record).
frozen chicken breast.review: Exception decided 2026-11-21: no plain frozen chicken record in Ciqual or USDA, so the raw record is used. Plain frozen raw chicken only; breaded, sauced or cooked products are never matched to it.

frozen chicken drumsticks.note: Chicken drumstick, raw, used for plain frozen drumsticks (stated exception: no frozen record).
frozen chicken drumsticks.review: Exception decided 2026-11-21: no plain frozen chicken record in Ciqual or USDA, so the raw record is used. Plain frozen raw chicken only; breaded, sauced or cooked products are never matched to it.

frozen chicken thigh.note: Chicken thigh without skin, raw, used for plain frozen chicken thigh (stated exception: no frozen record).
frozen chicken thigh.review: Exception decided 2026-11-21: no plain frozen chicken record in Ciqual or USDA, so the raw record is used. Plain frozen raw chicken only; breaded, sauced or cooked products are never matched to it.

frozen edamame.note: Frozen edamame, unprepared. No edamame in Ciqual.
frozen edamame.review: Shelled beans assumed; edamame in pods weigh more per bean.

frozen mixed berries.note: Frozen raspberries, unsweetened, as a stand-in for a mixed berry pack.
frozen mixed berries.review: No frozen mixed berry record with energy in either source. Mixes heavy in strawberries are about 20 kcal lower per 100 g.

frozen salmon.note: Farmed salmon, raw, used for plain frozen salmon fillets (stated exception: no frozen salmon record).
frozen salmon.review: Exception decided 2026-11-21: no plain frozen salmon record in Ciqual or USDA (only breaded products), so the raw farmed salmon record is used. Plain frozen fillets only; breaded salmon is never matched to it.

frozen stir-fry vegetables.review: Plain mix assumed. Seasoned stir-fry packs with oil (Ciqual 20273) have about 5 g fat.

granola.note: Granola with fruit, with or without nuts and seeds, not fortified.

grated cheese.review: Grated cheese packs vary (emmental, mozzarella or a mix); emmental used.

greek yogurt.review: European Greek-style yogurt is creamy and low in protein (3 g). Strained Greek yogurt (USDA) has about 9 g; check the label.

greek yogurt 0%.note: Greek yogurt, plain, nonfat. No 0% Greek yogurt in Ciqual.

ground beef.review: Fat in minced beef packs ranges 5 to 20%; 10% used. Ciqual has 5% (6250), 15% (6254) and 20% (6256). Check one Spanish label.

ground chicken.note: Ground chicken, raw. No ground chicken in Ciqual.
ground chicken.review: Ground chicken can include skin and thigh; a breast-only mince is leaner (closer to pechuga de pollo).

ground lamb.note: Ground lamb, raw. No ground lamb in Ciqual.

ground pork.note: Ground pork, raw. No ground pork in Ciqual.
ground pork.review: Fat in ground pork packs ranges about 10 to 25%; this record lists 17.5 g fat. Pork loin is far leaner (6 g).

ground turkey.note: Ground turkey 93% lean, raw. No ground turkey in Ciqual.
ground turkey.review: Fat in ground turkey packs ranges about 2 to 15%; 93% lean used (this record lists 9.6 g fat). Check one Spanish label.

jalapeno.note: Jalapeno pepper, raw. No jalapeno in Ciqual.

jam.note: Jam or marmalade, not reduced sugar (average).

jicama.note: Yam bean (jicama), raw. Not in Ciqual.

kalamata olives.review: No kalamata record; generic black olive in brine used.

lamb chops.note: Lamb chops, raw (average, weighed without bone).

light cream cheese.note: Plain spreadable fresh cheese, reduced fat.

light fresh cheese.note: Fresh cheese, petit-suisse type, 0% fat, as the closest to a light Burgos.
light fresh cheese.review: Low confidence: no Burgos record. Light Burgos labels range from 0 to about 5% fat; check one.

light mozzarella.note: Part skim mozzarella. No light mozzarella in Ciqual.
light mozzarella.review: Low confidence: USDA part skim is a firm, low moisture cheese. Fresh light mozzarella balls are lower in kcal; check a label.

manchego cheese.note: Ossau-Iraty, a firm ewe's milk cheese, used for cured Manchego.
manchego cheese.review: No Manchego record. Ossau-Iraty is a pressed ewe's milk cheese like cured Manchego; Pecorino (12122) has about 40 kcal less.

melon.note: Honeydew melon flesh, raw, used for Spanish piel de sapo.
melon.review: No piel de sapo record; it is a winter melon like honeydew. Cantaloupe is its own food.

microwave rice.note: Cooked white rice, no salt (ready-to-heat cups).
microwave rice.review: Cups may be white or brown rice and may contain a little oil. Brown cooked rice is Ciqual 9103.

nopales.note: Nopales (cactus pads), raw. Not in Ciqual.

oat drink.note: Oat drink, no added sugar, not fortified.

onion powder.note: Onion powder. Ciqual has dried onion but not the powder.

poblano pepper.note: Poblano pepper, seeded, raw. No poblano in Ciqual.

popcorn.review: Microwave and oil-popped popcorn have 30 to 45 g fat per 100 g (USDA 167549).

pork belly.review: Belly fat varies a lot by cut: Ciqual 28479 lists 29 g fat, USDA 167812 lists 53 g.

pork loin.review: Spanish lomo is the lean loin. Ciqual 'échine' (also translated loin) is the fatty neck end and was not used.

pork ribs.note: Pork spare ribs, raw (weighed without bone).

pork sausages.review: Fresh pork sausages to cook (Ciqual 30110) have about 320 kcal; frankfurters about 280.

pumpkin.review: Spanish calabaza can be pumpkin or butternut; butternut (Ciqual 20138) has about 10 kcal more per 100 g.

pumpkin seeds.note: Pumpkin seed kernels (pepitas), raw. Not in Ciqual.

quark 0%.note: Fresh cheese, petit-suisse type, 0% fat: closer to the high protein queso fresco batido 0% sold in Spain than plain quark.
quark 0%.review: Plain quark 0% (Ciqual 19644) has about 25% less protein; use it if the pack is plain quark.

queso fresco.review: Mexican queso fresco (299 kcal) is richer than Spanish queso fresco de Burgos (light Burgos is its own food).

refried beans.review: Restaurant refried beans (USDA 167666) have about 5 g more fat per 100 g.

rice noodles.note: Rice noodles, dry (dry grams). No rice noodles in Ciqual.

ricotta.note: Brousse, a fresh whey cheese like Italian ricotta.
ricotta.review: Brousse is ewe's milk; Italian cow's milk ricotta is close in kcal with a little less protein. Spanish requeson maps to cottage cheese instead (aliases.json), which is closer to its labels.

roasted red peppers.review: No roasted pepper record; jarred roasted peppers are canned red peppers. Ones packed in oil have more fat.

rolled oats.review: USDA used: Ciqual oat flakes (32140) list 10.6 g protein, well under typical labels (13 to 14 g). USDA carbs include about 10 g fiber.

salsa verde.note: Mexican green salsa (tomatillo), ready to serve.
salsa verde.review: Mexican salsa verde. The Basque parsley sauce of the same name is made with oil and is much richer.

sea bass.note: Sea bass, raw. No sea bass in Ciqual.

skyr.note: Nonfat strained (Greek) yogurt, used for skyr.
skyr.review: No skyr record in either source. Spanish skyr labels can be lower in kcal and protein than this record; check one label.

smoked paprika.note: Paprika powder; smoking does not change the macros.

sour cream.note: Sour cream, full fat. No sour cream in Ciqual.

spanish omelette.note: Spanish potato omelette with onions, prepacked.

spring onion.note: Spring onion or scallion, tops and bulb, raw.
spring onion.review: USDA used: the Ciqual record (11003) mixes chives and spring onion.

sunflower seeds.review: Ciqual has only the roasted salted kernels; raw kernels (USDA 2515381) have about 55 kcal less.

sweet corn.note: Sweet corn kernels, fresh, raw (corn on the cob).
sweet corn.review: Weigh the kernels, not the cob. Canned sweetcorn is its own food.

textured soy protein.note: Defatted soy flour, used for dry textured soy (dry grams).
textured soy protein.review: No dry textured soy record. Textured soy is extruded defatted soy flour, so macros match; Ciqual has only the rehydrated form (20591).

tomato salsa.note: Salsa, ready to serve (Mexican tomato salsa). Not in Ciqual.

tomato sauce.review: Closest to Spanish tomate frito; brands vary in oil and sugar.

turkey tenderloin.note: Turkey breast escalope, raw (tenderloin is breast meat).

vanilla whey protein.note: Whey-based protein powder, used for whey protein isolate powder.
vanilla whey protein.review: No plain whey isolate record in Ciqual. USDA 173180 (78 g protein, 6 g carbs per 100 g) is closer to isolate labels than USDA 173177 'Whey protein powder isolate' (58 g protein, 29 g carbs). Flavour and brand change carbs a little; use Open Food Facts by barcode for an exact label.

whole chicken.note: Chicken meat and skin, raw (weighed without bone).
